statement.zh: **事件**：Kyber 选为后量子标准（Kyber Selected as PQC Standard）。FIPS 203 §1.1 说明标准规定的是所选算法的一个变体：「ML-KEM is derived from the round-three version of the CRYSTALS-KYBER KEM [4], a submission in the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization project」；公告第 10 项记录「ML-KEM is the name given to the algorithm in this standard derived from CRYSTALS-KYBER」，并说明 NIST 已就采用该选定算法签订两项专利许可协议。
statement.en: **Event**: Kyber Selected as PQC Standard.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography, dated 2023.

statement.zh: 入选是经过多轮评估的结果：§1.2 写明「After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization」，并列出该方案的设计者名单（Schwabe、Avanzi、Bos、Ducas、Kiltz、Lepoint、Lyubashevsky、Schanck、Seiler、Stehlé 与 Ding）。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: IR 8547 §2.1.2 说明「FIPS 203 specifies a cryptographic scheme called Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), which is derived from the CRYSTALS-KYBER submission」；§4.1.2 记录，就这份 2026 年 10 月文件自身的时点而言「ML-KEM is the only approved post-quantum key-establishment scheme based on public-key cryptography」，并写明「NIST recommends using ML-KEM-768 as the default parameter set」；§3.2.1 说明通用复合（hybrid）密钥建立技术允许与传统方案组合。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 2023 年对应的是草案而非定稿：附录 C.2 记录相关内容曾收入「the initial public draft (ipd) of FIPS 203, which was posted on August 24, 2023」，正式版封面日期为 2024 年 8 月 13 日；此外 §1 明确标准规定的是 Kyber 的变体，并且第四轮后 NIST 又选定 HQC 作为 ML-KEM 的替代（IR 8547 §2.1.2），因此`唯一选项`的表述并不成立。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 时间线为：CRYSTALS-KYBER 作为 NIST 后量子标准化项目的提交进入第三轮评估，2023 年 8 月 24 日以 FIPS 203 初始公开草案形式公布，2024 年 8 月 13 日 FIPS 203 正式发布并即时生效；IR 8547（2026 年 10 月）把 ML-KEM 记为该提交的产物，并列出后续 HQC 备选。
statement.en: Registered period: Post-quantum Era.The registered year is 2023; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
